# Krisala Hiranandani Master Township Hinjewadi, Pune

> Official canonical documentation and structured knowledge graph for Krisala Hiranandani Township, a 105+ acre integrated neoclassical equestrian township in North Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra.

## Overview
- Project Name: Krisala × Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi
- Developers: Joint venture between Hiranandani Communities (led by Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani) and Krisala Developers
- Land Area: 105+ Acres master-planned development
- Architecture: Signature Neoclassical with monolithic Mivan shear-wall construction
- Location: North Hinjewadi (Darumbre), Pune, Maharashtra 410506, India
- Key Features: India's 1st 8-acre private turf racecourse & equestrian club, 40-acre Della adventure resort precinct, 70% open landscaped green spaces, 52+ world-class amenities.

## Official MahaRERA Registrations
- Sector Arcadia: MahaRERA No. PR1260002500600
- The Colosseum (Phase 4): MahaRERA No. PR1260002600818
- Sector Everlyn: MahaRERA No. PR1260002502438
- Official Verification Portal: https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/

## Residential Enclaves & Configurations
- Sector Arcadia: 2 & 3 BHK Neoclassical Residences (740 sq.ft. to 1,020 sq.ft. carpet), starting from ₹79 Lakhs all-inclusive.
- The Colosseum (Phase 4): B+G+27 Roman-inspired landmark towers featuring 3 & 4 BHK residences with private balconies facing the racecourse, starting from ₹1.25 Crore.
- Sector Icon: Ultra-luxury triad towers (Towers A, B & C) with signature 3 & 4 BHK Sky Duplexes and penthouses, starting from ₹2.10 Crore to ₹2.65 Crore.
- The Della Collection: 100 bespoke luxury resort villa plots with complete Della Adventure & Polo membership, starting from ₹1.80 Crore.
- Sector Everlyn: Lake-facing residences with dedicated butterfly park and nature trails.

## Official 2026 Price List & Cost Sheet
- 2 BHK Smart Luxury (740 sq.ft. carpet): Starting at ₹79 Lakhs* all-inclusive
- 2 BHK Grand Neoclassical (825 sq.ft. carpet): Starting at ₹88 Lakhs* all-inclusive
- 3 BHK Imperial (1,020 sq.ft. carpet): Starting at ₹1.25 Crore* all-inclusive
- 3 BHK Colosseum Racecourse View (1,180 sq.ft. carpet): Starting at ₹1.45 Crore* all-inclusive
- 4 BHK Sky Duplex / Penthouse (1,850 sq.ft. carpet): Starting at ₹2.10 Crore* all-inclusive
- Della Resort Villa Plots (1,500 – 3,500 sq.ft.): Starting at ₹1.80 Crore*
- Pune Stamp Duty (2026): 7% (5% Stamp Duty + 1% Local Body Tax + 1% Metro Cess) + ₹30,000 Registration Fee.
- GST: 5% on residential under-construction units.

## Strategic Connectivity & Transit
- PMRDA 128m Ring Road: 5 minutes (Direct expressway connector)
- Pune Metro Line 3 (Megapolis Station): 7 minutes
- Mumbai-Pune Expressway (Urse Toll Plaza): 10 minutes (75-minute commute to Navi Mumbai International Airport)
- Hinjewadi Phase 1 IT Park (Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Cognizant): 12 minutes signal-free commute
- Balewadi High Street / Baner: 20 minutes
